summary: Inmune Bio filed an 8-K to disclose an amended and restated Material Transfer and License Agreement with its wholly-owned subsidiary INmune Bio International and Anthony Nolan. The agreement secures long-term supply of umbilical cord tissue for Inmune's CORDStrom platform. Royalty terms include a 2% royalty on net sales up to an annual cap of 5,000,000 and service fees of 400 plus VAT per tissue sample. This is a routine operational/licensing agreement with no change of control, shareholder vote, or special situation event.
